protein: Cellular tumor antigen p53 (Tumor suppressor p53) (Phosphoprotein p53) (Antigen NY-CO-13)
db_reference: SWISS-PROT P04637, P53_HUMAN. NLSdb NLS:76, NLS:127
necessity: L348A/L350A does not shuttle in heterokaryon assay (Stommel et al. 1999)
sufficiency: Aa 339-352 mediates export of BSA (stommel et al. 1999). Zhang and Xiong 2001 further shows aa 11-27 to mediate export of GFP, which is abrogated by the L14Q/F19S or L22Q/W23S mutations. This is argued though, by Inoue et al. 2002, who shows that p53 aa 7-27 cannot function as an autonomous NES.

comments: There is controversy regarding the N-terminal NES (Zhang and Xiong 2001, Inoue et al. 2002), why it has not been included in the assignment field.
references: Stommel JM, Marchenko ND, Jimenez GS, Moll UM, Hope TJ and Wahl GM, 1999 EMBO J 18: 1660-72. Medline: 10075936 Zhang Y and Xiong Y, 2001, Science 292: 1910-5. Medline: 11397945 Inoue T, Stuart J, Leno R, Maki CG, 2002, J. Biol. Chem. 277: 15053-60. Medline: 11847229
